I Performed a Jira search and reviewed similar ticket DOSDP-69620. Found a previously reported issue for the NARITA device with the same behavior.

That ticket was closed with the conclusion that the CDM ingestion service relies on the MaxMind GeoIP database for location data, which may not always provide complete information. Fields such as geoDetail.region and geoDetail.city can be missing due to data limitations, country-specific restrictions, or incomplete mappings. This is expected behavior and outside the control of the CDM service.

Based on the current analysis and confirmation from Marcelo Galeriano this issue falls under the same category.

*Summary:*

The ticket can be closed after updating the Data Quality rules for geoDetail fields (region, city, country_code), as these fields are not reliable for null value checks.

comments.author: Bidyasagar Pradhan
comments.body:
*Update:*

Performed a Jira search and reviewed similar ticket DOSDP-69620. Found a previously reported issue for the NARITA device with the same behavior.

That ticket was closed with the conclusion that the CDM ingestion service relies on the MaxMind GeoIP database for location data, which may not always provide complete information. Fields such as geoDetail.region and geoDetail.city can be missing due to data limitations, country-specific restrictions, or incomplete mappings. This is expected behavior and outside the control of the CDM service.

Based on the current analysis, this issue falls under the same category.

Next Steps (as discussed with Garrett):
 * Update the profiler_rules.csv data profiling rules for missing/null values in geo fields.
 * Apply this update across all devices, as the limitation is not device-specific.

comments.author: Bidyasagar Pradhan
comments.body:
*Update:*

I have reached out to Marcelo Galeriano for clarification on the rules associated with the country_code field, as it was not part of the previous ticket DOSDP-69620.

He confirmed, this behavior is due to GeoIP data limitations (MaxMind). GeoIP information is non-deterministic and not guaranteed to be complete, so fields like city, region, and even country_code can occasionally be null for certain IPs.

This is expected behavior and not a defect in the system.

*Summary:*

The ticket can be closed after updating the Data Quality rules for geoDetail fields (region, city, country_code), as these fields are not reliable for null value checks.
